services.name: Eugene Skydivers
services.desc: Eugene Skydivers has been at the Creswell airport just minutes south of Eugene since 1992. We invite you to join us at beautiful Creswell Hobby Airfield and hope you’ll make Eugene Skydivers your home dz! Eugene Skydivers is a USPA Group Member so you must have a current USPA membership to jump with us. Temporary USPA memberships are available for visiting skydivers. In addition, you MUST have an in-date and functional AAD system fitted to your container system. Eugene Skydivers observes the USPA BSR’s with regard to your Skydiving License. The main landing area is a right-hand pattern. We do not cross over the runway under 1000’ AGL. You will be briefed prior to jumping on the landing
